description: This file defines the interface for ProxyResolutionService, a component responsible for determining appropriate proxy servers for URL requests within the Chromium project. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and references to related classes and external files.

classes.name: net::ProxyResolutionService
classes.description: An interface class that provides methods for proxy resolution, success reporting, proxy management, and diagnostics within the Chromium network stack.

methods.name: ResolveProxy
methods.description: Determines the appropriate proxy for a given URL and request method, returning a status code or indicating pending resolution.

methods.name: ReportSuccess
methods.description: Reports a successful proxy connection, potentially updating proxy retry information.

methods.name: SetProxyDelegate
methods.description: Associates a delegate with the proxy resolution service for callback or event handling.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Prepares the service for shutdown by canceling ongoing requests and preventing new ones.

methods.name: MarkProxiesAsBadUntil
methods.description: Marks specified proxies as bad until a certain time, optionally adding additional proxies to the bad list.

methods.name: ClearBadProxiesCache
methods.description: Clears the cache of proxies marked as bad.

methods.name: proxy_retry_info
methods.description: Returns a map of proxies that have been marked as bad and are subject to retry logic.

methods.name: GetProxyNetLogValues
methods.description: Provides diagnostic information related to proxy resolution for logging.

methods.name: CastToConfiguredProxyResolutionService
methods.description: Attempts to cast the interface to a more specific implementation type.
